social_circle.name: Farah Mustapha

demographics.education: high school diploma plus office and medical billing training

background.how_they_met: She is Man Mustapha's mother and raised him in the Pittsburgh metro area after immigrating from Pakistan before he was born.
background.why_close: They are in frequent contact, and she remains one of the main family figures in his life. She checks on his eating, prayer, savings, health care paperwork, and general stability.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Texts in full sentences, often with practical reminders. Mixes English with occasional Urdu phrases, sends WhatsApp family updates, and follows up if he gives a vague answer.

shared_activities: weekly Sunday dinner or family meal
health insurance and billing paperwork help
checking in about food, prayer, savings, and appointments
recent_text_topics: Reminding him to eat properly during heavy storm-call weeks and not drink too much coffee.
Asking him to help interpret an insurance portal message or bill for the family.
Planning Sunday dinner, Eid-related family visits, and whether he can bring anything home-cooked.
Checking whether his shoulder or sleep has been better after long workdays.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q05 says his mother is one of the main family members in his life and that 'My mom texts almost daily.' Q103 identifies her work as medical billing and front-office clerk. Q101 says she completed high school and office/billing training. Q36 and Q40 show he helps with forms, portals, and bills. Name is inferred because the transcript names her role but not her first name.

social_circle.name: Tariq Mustapha

demographics.occupation: building maintenance and electrical repair worker
demographics.education: technical or vocational training in electrical and maintenance-related work

background.how_they_met: He is Man Mustapha's father and helped raise him in Monroeville. His own maintenance and electrical repair work shaped Man's respect for hands-on technical labor.
background.why_close: Their bond is practical rather than highly emotional. They connect through cars, tools, work safety, electrical troubleshooting, and quiet support around Man's trade path.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Short, direct texts and calls. Uses few emojis, asks concrete questions, and shows care through reminders about boots, tires, tools, and safety.

shared_activities: short calls about car and work issues
talking about electrical work and tools
recent_text_topics: Checking whether Man's car tires, brakes, and work boots are holding up.
Talking through whether part-time electrical engineering technology study is worth the cost and schedule strain.
Asking for help with an online medical portal message or appointment logistics.
Brief updates about blood pressure, diet, and whether Man can drive him to an appointment.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q05 says his dad is important and 'shows care by checking my car tires or asking if my boots are holding up,' and that they talk about twice a week. Q106 says his father worked in building maintenance and electrical repair. Q100 says he completed technical or vocational training. Name is inferred because the transcript names the father role but not his first name.

social_circle.name: Ayesha Mustapha

background.how_they_met: She is Man's younger sister; they grew up together in the same Monroeville household with both parents.
background.why_close: They are close in a low-key sibling way. She sends memes, asks him for laptop help, discusses music and politics with him, and is one of the few people who knows something about his anxiety.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Fast, casual texter who sends memes, links, screenshots, and occasional long opinionated messages. More likely than Man to use emojis, internet slang, and blunt encouragement.

recent_text_topics: Sending him new music and asking what ambient or indie tracks he has been listening to.
Pushing him to take anxiety and sleep more seriously instead of only managing it alone.
Debating race, policing, performative politics, and family conversations after dinner.
Asking him to fix or diagnose laptop issues before exams.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q05 explicitly names 'my younger sister, Ayesha' and says they are close, she sends memes, asks him to fix her laptop, and they talk about music. Q29-Q30 say he discusses race and policing with his sister and that she is the most outspoken influence. Q45 says his sister knows some about his anxiety.

social_circle.name: Sameer Khan

background.how_they_met: Sameer and Man met in high school in the Pittsburgh area and stayed close after graduation.
background.why_close: Sameer knows Man's quieter side and can tell when he is overthinking. Their friendship is built around low-pressure hangouts, food, sports, and private emotional support.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Casual SMS/iMessage style with short jokes, Pittsburgh references, game reactions, and check-in texts. Uses memes and dry humor but gets serious when Man is anxious.

shared_activities: occasional conversations about politics and family
recent_text_topics: Trying to pick a night for coffee or late-night fries around Man's unpredictable overtime.
Reacting to Steelers news and joking about whether either of them will actually be free for a game.
Checking in when Man is overthinking work decisions or comparing himself to college peers.
Talking quietly about politics, race, and local issues without posting publicly.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q07 says 'Sameer is my closest friend from high school' and that they get coffee or late-night fries about twice a month and watch Steelers games. Q07 also says Sameer can tell when Man is overthinking. Q29 says Man talks with Sameer about race and policing. Surname and occupation are inferred because only his first name and friendship role are documented.

social_circle.name: Luis Rivera
social_circle.relationship: coworker mentor and personal support contact

demographics.occupation: senior utility crew member / power-line worker
demographics.education: high school diploma plus apprenticeship and utility safety training

background.how_they_met: They met through Man's utility crew. Luis became an older mentor who taught him how to stay calm under pressure on job sites.
background.why_close: Although they met at work, Luis has crossed into Man's personal support circle. Man texts him when a work incident is replaying in his head, and Luis helps him separate useful review from anxiety.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Brief, steady texts with practical reassurance. Uses voice notes or short calls when a topic is serious, and tends to answer anxiety with procedure, facts, and perspective.

shared_activities: job-site mentoring that sometimes continues by personal text
recent_text_topics: A freezing-rain outage call that Man kept replaying after work.
Reminders that reviewing a procedure is useful but punishing himself is not.
Advice about union pathways, certifications, and staying calm on crews with changing weather conditions.
Checking whether Man is sleeping enough during heavy storm weeks.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q07 identifies Luis as an older crew member Man is closest with at work and says he taught Man to stay calm under pressure. Q44 says Man texted Luis after a rough outage call and Luis talked him through what happened. Q49 says Man texts Sameer, his sister, or sometimes Luis for support. Surname is inferred because only first name is documented.
